categories.main_business_segments: Eastone Century Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in communication network technology services, including network engineering, maintenance, and optimization services. It also provides system solutions, communication network equipment sales, IoT platforms and solutions, and ICT services. The company serves telecom operators and enterprises with integrated end-to-end solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced communication technologies such as 5G, AIoT, edge computing, and big data. It develops proprietary products including 5G communication components, IoT platforms with low-code development tools, AI applications, and aviation software. Its production methods emphasize R&D-driven innovation, system integration, and digital transformation solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Chinese telecom operators such as China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, and China Tower. The company also serves government and enterprise clients in sectors like industrial internet, smart cities, and low-altitude economy. Its markets span telecom infrastructure, IoT applications, and emerging digital economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily across China with significant presence in South China, North China, East China, Central China, and Western China regions. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, the United States, Indonesia, and other locations, supporting a nationwide and partial international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Eastone Century functions mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the telecom supply chain, providing integrated network engineering, maintenance, optimization services, and system solutions. It also manufactures communication network equipment, positioning itself as both a service provider and equipment supplier within the telecom ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in 5G applications, IoT platforms, AI-driven digital solutions, and industrial internet integration. It focuses on developing low-code IoT tools, AI-powered smart assistants, aviation software, and smart manufacturing technologies. Strategic initiatives include expanding into new energy, low-altitude economy, and digital transformation services, supported by sustained innovation and industry collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service contracts with telecom operators for network engineering, maintenance, and optimization. Additional income comes from sales of communication network equipment, system integration projects, IoT platform operations, and ICT solutions. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies related to its technology and infrastructure projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with telecom service providers and equipment manufacturers including Huawei, ZTE, Ericsson, and Nokia. It holds a strong market position as a nationwide, full-chain integrated service provider with comprehensive capabilities in telecom network services and emerging digital economy sectors. Its diversified business and strategic partnerships enhance its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.5 billion, a slight decline from the previous year. Net profit was negative due to reduced revenue, gross margin contraction, and goodwill impairment. Despite short-term challenges, the company maintains stable operations with ongoing investments in R&D and strategic business expansion, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eastone Century emphasizes its comprehensive 'service + product' strategy, offering end-to-end telecom network solutions with strong integration capabilities. Its unique value lies in advanced technology adoption (5G, AIoT, edge computing), low-code IoT platform development, and tailored industry applications. The company’s extensive nationwide service network and strong client relationships provide reliable, high-quality, and innovative solutions that differentiate it in a competitive market.
